changeSet.author: lifefit
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0087. One platform Google Drive connection and OAuth app, managed by SuperAdmin. Index review: PK_PlatformStorageConnections; UX_PlatformStorageConnections_Provider keeps a single live row per provider. No tenant foreign key. Performance note: file uploads read this one row. The client secret and refresh token are stored only as protected ciphertext.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE app.PlatformStorageConnections ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, Provider NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, ClientId NVARCHAR(200) NULL, ProtectedClientSecret NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, RedirectUri NVARCHAR(500) NULL, AccountEmail NVARCHAR(320) NULL, RootFolderId NVARCHAR(128) NULL, MembersFolderId NVARCHAR(128) NULL, CommunicationsFolderId NVARCHAR(128) NULL, GymFolderId NVARCHAR(128) NULL, OtherFolderId NVARCHAR(128) NULL, ProtectedRefreshToken NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, GrantedScopes NVARCHAR(500) NULL, ConnectedByUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, ConnectedAt DATETIME2 NULL, LastValidatedAt DATETIME2 NULL, LastError NVARCHAR(500) NULL, StoreProgressPhotos BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_PlatformStorageConnections_StoreProgressPhotos DEFAULT (1), ProgressFolderId NVARCHAR(128) NULL, ProgressFolderName NVARCHAR(200) NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_PlatformStorageConnections PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PlatformStorageConnections_Users FOREIGN KEY (ConnectedByUserId) REFERENCES app.Users (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_PlatformStorageConnections_Provider CHECK (Provider = N'GoogleDrive'), CONSTRAINT CK_PlatformStorageConnections_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'NotConnected', N'Connecting', N'Connected', N'Failed', N'Revoked')) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PlatformStorageConnections_Provider ON app.PlatformStorageConnections (Provider) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;
